title: 风把纸船送回岸边
logline: 一只红色纸船在平静水面遭遇微风，短暂偏航后沿着倒影找到岸边。

expectations.purpose: 把长片风险压缩到可复查的首个样片。
expectations.success: 最终时间线精确为 30 秒并包含六个顺序固定的镜头。
expectations.observable: 成片时长、镜头边界和时间线清单。
expectations.evidence: 组装清单、媒体探测记录和文件摘要。
expectations.acceptable_gap: 候选阶段允许单镜头尚未生成，不允许组装时缺镜头。
expectations.authority: 系统可检查结构，不能代替人工接受创意质量。

expectations.purpose: 保持红色纸船、日光方向与水面环境连续。
expectations.success: 六个镜头中的主体身份、主色和运动方向没有明显跳变。
expectations.observable: 逐镜头首尾帧、主体颜色和屏幕运动方向。
expectations.evidence: 候选缩略图、首尾帧接触表和人工复审记录。
expectations.acceptable_gap: 轻微水纹变化可接受；主体消失、换色或方向反转不可接受。
expectations.authority: 检查器只报告观察，最终连续性由人工选择权威决定。

expectations.purpose: 证明免费本地路线能形成可观看而非仅可运行的短片。
expectations.success: 主体可辨、运动稳定、无乱码文字、无严重形变，达到 1280×720 交付画面。
expectations.observable: 分辨率、稳定性、主体完整性和人工观看结果。
expectations.evidence: 媒体元数据、逐帧探针、候选比较和人工选择记录。
expectations.acceptable_gap: 结构预览可低于交付分辨率，但不得被标记为质量通过。
expectations.authority: 本地生成器只能产生候选，不能声明质量通过。

shots.title: 起
shots.purpose: 建立红色纸船、平静水面和柔和日光。
shots.generation_prompt: A small red folded origami paper boat with clearly visible triangular creases rests on calm shallow water, static camera, soft morning daylight, simple background, gentle ripples, no people, no text.
shots.continuity_in: 故事起点；纸船完整，船头朝画面右侧。
shots.continuity_out: 纸船开始缓慢向右漂动。
observable_checks: 红色折纸船从第一帧可辨
三角纸面和主要折痕持续存在

shots.title: 漂
shots.purpose: 展示纸船沿水面平稳前行。
shots.generation_prompt: The same small red folded origami paper boat with clearly visible triangular creases drifts slowly from left to right across calm shallow water, static camera, soft morning daylight, simple background, gentle ripples, no people, no text.
shots.continuity_in: 承接向右运动，纸船外观与光线不变。
observable_checks: 折纸船颜色、三角纸面与折痕连续

shots.title: 遇风
shots.purpose: 微风改变水纹并制造第一次小冲突。
shots.generation_prompt: The same small red folded origami paper boat with clearly visible triangular creases remains intact as a gentle breeze creates stronger ripples and a slight tilt, static camera, soft morning daylight, simple background, no people, no text.
shots.continuity_in: 纸船继续向右，水纹逐渐增强。
shots.continuity_out: 船头轻微偏向画面左前方。
observable_checks: 折纸船只轻微倾斜且折痕未破损

shots.title: 转向
shots.purpose: 让纸船在水流中完成可读的方向调整。
shots.generation_prompt: The same small red folded origami paper boat with clearly visible triangular creases gently turns in a curved current toward a quiet shoreline, static camera, soft morning daylight, three-quarter view, simple background, smooth motion, no people, no text.
shots.continuity_in: 从轻微偏航开始，纸船仍完整。
shots.continuity_out: 纸船对准远处安静岸边。

shots.title: 穿过倒影
shots.purpose: 以暖色倒影形成抵达前的视觉高潮。
shots.generation_prompt: The same small red folded origami paper boat with clearly visible triangular creases glides through a warm golden reflection on calm water toward the shoreline, static camera, soft morning sunlight, simple background, delicate ripples, no people, no text.
shots.continuity_in: 纸船朝岸边前进，光线开始变暖。
shots.continuity_out: 岸边进入近景，纸船速度放缓。

shots.title: 抵达
shots.purpose: 让纸船轻触岸边并稳定结束。
shots.generation_prompt: The same small red folded origami paper boat with clearly visible triangular creases arrives gently at a quiet shoreline, touches wet sand and comes to rest, static camera, warm soft daylight, calm water, simple background, no people, no text.
shots.continuity_in: 纸船从暖色倒影驶向同一岸边。
shots.continuity_out: 纸船完整停靠，画面平静收束。
